name: BGS OGC API collection discovery

licence.name: Collection-specific; inspect collection metadata
licence.scope: Discovery metadata does not grant unrestricted reuse of every collection. Follow each collection licence and linked product terms.

attribution: Use the attribution of the selected collection; BGS material commonly requires: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026.
limitations: Service is labelled BETA and can change.
Implemented collection discovery is not an adapter for every BGS dataset.
Coverage, scale and access depend on the collection.

name: BGS borehole index discovery

licence.name: Open Government Licence v3.0 for the open index
licence.scope: The public borehole index is open; linked scans, reports, confidential records and third-party test data may have separate rights/access conditions.

attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026.
limitations: Index discovery does not extract or validate SPT/CPT/laboratory test results.
The index is incomplete and location/record quality varies.
Nearby boreholes do not establish ground conditions at the site; absent records do not mean no investigation exists.

name: BGS geology at 1:625,000

licence.name: Open Government Licence v3.0
licence.scope: Applies to BGS Geology 625K, not automatically to 1:50,000 mapping or other commercial BGS products.

attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026.
limitations: National overview at 1:625,000; unsuitable for resolving site-scale geology or design parameters.
Mapped geology is an interpretation and is not a measured stratigraphic profile.
Do not infer soil strength, stiffness, groundwater depth or founding depth from these polygons.

name: BGS recorded landslide inventory discovery

licence.name: Public layer terms; check collection metadata and BGS guidance
licence.scope: Public inventory/map-layer access only; follow current BGS licence and usage guidance. The GeoIndex guide states the data must not be used for insurance purposes.

attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026.
limitations: Inventory of recorded events, not a landslide susceptibility or probability model.
Point locations do not map the entire affected footprint.
Incomplete and biased toward documented events; absence of a record does not establish safety.
Excludes Northern Ireland, Isle of Man and Channel Islands.

name: BGS available AGS investigation data index

licence.name: Dataset and donor permission dependent
licence.scope: The implemented tool discovers index records and links. Reuse/download rights and the exported AGS groups must be checked for each record; donor consent controls availability.

attribution: Contains British Geological Survey materials © UKRI 2026. Retain original investigation/data-owner attribution where supplied.
limitations: Not all investigations or AGS groups are available.
Does not parse/download arbitrary AGS files or certify tests.
Preserve units, methods, depth and original provenance before using test values.

name: Environment Agency flood-monitoring API
coverage: England service; some water-level records may be from Wales

licence.name: Open Government Licence v3.0
licence.scope: EA real-time flood and river-level data API; retain record ownership where Welsh data are included.

attribution: This uses Environment Agency flood and river level data from the real-time data API (Beta).
limitations: Current alerts and gauge observations are not a site-specific flood-risk assessment.
No warning or nearby station does not mean no flood risk.
Retrieval time differs from measurement time; telemetry updates can be delayed.
Coverage is not UK-wide and the provider gives no safety-critical availability guarantee.

name: Environment Agency Hydrology API
coverage: England / EA monitoring service; inspect station metadata

licence.name: Open Government Licence v3.0
licence.scope: Data returned by the Hydrology API with its licence metadata; retain specific record attribution and quality flags.

attribution: Contains Environment Agency information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
limitations: Parameters, measurement datum, units, interval and quality differ between series.
A nearby surface-water gauge is not a site groundwater measurement.
Not a complete UK-wide hydrometric service.

name: Planning Data platform
provider: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government / data publishers

licence.name: Dataset-specific; most data under OGL
licence.scope: Use each dataset licence and attribution-text from dataset metadata; the platform includes third-party intellectual property.

attribution: Use the exact attribution-text returned in the selected dataset metadata, including publisher and OS credits where present.
limitations: Coverage, completeness and duplication vary by dataset and local authority.
A missing constraint in the platform does not establish planning approval or the absence of a restriction.
England only; authoritative legal records may require checking the originating authority.

name: data.gov.uk / National Data Library directory

licence.name: Dataset/distribution-specific
licence.scope: An open catalogue is not a blanket licence for the datasets it describes. Licence may be missing and records can describe restricted products.

attribution: Attribute each original dataset publisher and follow the resource licence.
limitations: Metadata/distribution discovery, not automatic access to all referenced data.
Links and metadata can be stale.
Catalogue inclusion does not prove an API is public, functional or appropriate for the proposed use.

name: OS OpenData discovery and download metadata

licence.name: Product-specific; OS-owned OpenData commonly OGL, third-party products have their own terms
licence.scope: No-key product discovery may include third-party products. Apply OGL only to OS-owned OpenData explicitly under it; use each product provider and documentation for third-party licence and attribution. Discovery does not cover Premium dataPackages or other licensed APIs.

attribution: Use each product provider and required attribution. OS-owned OpenData commonly requires Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026; third-party providers require their own credit.
limitations: Metadata/download-link tools do not query site features or download national archives.
Most OpenData products cover GB, not Northern Ireland.
Available formats, grid-square coverage and product versions vary.
The inventory can include BGS and other third-party products; an OS-hosted download listing is not a blanket OS/OGL licence.

name: DfT annual average daily flow statistics

licence.name: Open Government Licence; check product and third-party terms
licence.scope: Road-traffic statistics and downloadable products; retain source attribution and release metadata.

attribution: Department for Transport, Road Traffic Statistics; include dataset year and release.
limitations: Annual average daily flows include estimates and are not live traffic.
Traffic counts are not axle-load histories or direct design loading.
The current adapter queries annual average daily flow statistics only; it does not ingest bulk road geometry or all transport datasets.

name: National Highways Data Lab APIs

licence.name: National Highways service and dataset terms
licence.scope: Registration/subscription/API key required for Data Lab APIs; check each API and geospatial product licence.

attribution: Attribute National Highways and any other providers as required by the selected API terms.
limitations: Does not cover every UK road.
Current FAQ limits APIs to 10 calls per subscription key per minute.
Locations, closures and signs do not provide comprehensive structural condition or capacity.

name: TfL Unified API

licence.name: TfL Transport Data terms; third-party data terms apply
licence.scope: Register for app_key and follow current API/transport data terms. Third-party sources can impose additional attribution.

attribution: Follow TfL transport data terms and source attribution listed at https://tfl.gov.uk/corporate/data-sources.
limitations: Transport operations/status data is not a structural inspection dataset.
Coverage is not national.
Quota and caching requirements vary by service.

name: Network Rail open feeds and Rail Data Marketplace

licence.name: Feed/product-specific terms; selected feeds released under OGL principles
licence.scope: Registration and feed allocation may be required. Rail Data Marketplace includes both open and commercial products with separate terms.

attribution: Attribute Network Rail Infrastructure Limited or the actual data owner; do not call derived products official.
limitations: Open feeds are not complete track, earthwork, bridge or tunnel inspection records.
Infrastructure model, operational schedule and movement feeds have distinct semantics.
Network Rail account quotas/availability must be checked during onboarding.

name: Street Manager open roadworks events

licence.name: Open Government Licence (open roadworks feed)
licence.scope: Applies to open data feed. Operational permit creation/management APIs have separate restricted accounts and permissions.

attribution: Contains Department for Transport Street Manager information licensed under the Open Government Licence.
limitations: Requires a verified HTTPS POST receiver and persistent event ingestion.
Not a simple historic GET search endpoint.
Roadworks records do not prove the precise location, depth or existence of utilities.

name: National Underground Asset Register

licence.name: Legally enforceable access agreements and approved use cases
licence.scope: Operational service is invitation-only for participating asset owners and authorised contractors. Expansion testing does not create open access or a public API entitlement.

attribution: Follow the applicable NUAR agreement and individual asset-owner attribution/handling requirements.
limitations: No public NUAR connector is implemented.
Current FAQ restricts use to approved safe-dig/statutory purposes and lists exclusions including land acquisition and network expansion planning.
Recorded asset data is not a guarantee of exact location, depth or absence of other assets.
University/research status alone is not an access entitlement.

name: Scottish Community Apparatus Data Vault
provider: Scottish Road Works Commissioner / authorised asset owners
interface: Authorised Scottish Road Works Register service

licence.name: Service/asset-owner access agreements
licence.scope: Scotland has its own underground apparatus system; verify eligibility and direct service terms before integration.

attribution: Follow the authorised service and asset-owner requirements.
limitations: No public API or unrestricted data access is claimed.
NUAR geographic coverage does not include Scotland.
No connector is implemented in the current release.

name: Met Office Weather DataHub
coverage: United Kingdom and global coverage depending on product/model

licence.name: Weather DataHub licence and subscription terms
licence.scope: Free and paid plans depend on product and usage. API credentials and subscription are required; do not treat all Met Office data as unrestricted.

attribution: Powered by Met Office data.
limitations: Forecast model resolution and uncertainty must be retained.
Weather forecasts are not the same product as historic observations or climate projections.
Credentials, quotas and any paid use must be explicitly configured by the user.

name: National River Flow Archive
provider: UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology / monitoring authorities
coverage: United Kingdom gauging network; series-specific coverage

licence.name: NRFA Data Terms and Conditions
licence.scope: NRFA-specific API/data terms apply; do not substitute a blanket OGL declaration.

attribution: Data from the UK National River Flow Archive.
limitations: API documentation describes a test service that can change.
Station quality and temporal aggregation matter; daily flow is not sub-hourly peak flow.
River-flow measurements do not establish site groundwater level.

name: ONS Open Geography Portal
coverage: United Kingdom and constituent nations; product-specific

licence.name: Open Government Licence with applicable third-party rights
licence.scope: ONS intellectual property is OGL; third-party IP and attribution are product-specific.

attribution: Credit ONS and include the applicable product attribution/copyright statements.
limitations: Select the correct boundary date and level of generalisation.
Statistical boundaries are not cadastral or engineering survey boundaries.
Availability of a UK portal does not mean every layer covers all four nations.

name: ONS Beta statistics API

licence.name: Open Government Licence; check dataset rights
licence.scope: ONS data terms and any dataset-specific third-party rights apply.

attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics; retain dataset, edition and release/version.
limitations: Beta API may introduce breaking changes.
Dimensions, statistical geography and publication revisions need explicit handling.
Not a source of detailed engineering asset-condition records.

name: HM Land Registry open data
coverage: England and Wales; UK House Price Index has wider coverage

licence.name: Open Government Licence with dataset-specific attribution
licence.scope: Covers specified open products such as Price Paid and INSPIRE; does not cover every land/property product.

attribution: Use the exact HMLR attribution required by the product; INSPIRE geometry also requires the listed Ordnance Survey statement.
limitations: INSPIRE polygons show indicative positions rather than legally definitive boundaries.
Property ownership/addresses can carry additional rights and privacy obligations.
A download dataset is not automatically a point-query API.

name: HM Land Registry licensed datasets API

licence.name: Individual dataset licences; some free, some paid
licence.scope: Account/API key and explicit acceptance of each data licence are required; address data can have Royal Mail/OS restrictions.

attribution: Follow the selected dataset licence and third-party attribution.
limitations: No authenticated connector is implemented.
Some licences limit redistribution or use as a standalone product.
Signed download URLs expire quickly and should not be exposed in public logs.

name: Mining Remediation Authority maps and records
coverage: Great Britain coalfields; some other products cover England

licence.name: Dataset-specific open and licensed products
licence.scope: Selected map/catalogue access is free; copies, detailed searches and some datasets can require payment or licences.

attribution: Attribute the Mining Remediation Authority and follow product-specific terms.
limitations: Viewing a map does not permit unrestricted bulk redistribution of all mine plans.
Historical records are incomplete and not a ground-stability guarantee.
Detailed mine workings/borehole data may need a licensed report or supplied records.

name: SEPA Time Series Data Service

licence.name: Open Government Licence v3.0
licence.scope: SEPA identifies hydrometric API data as OGL. Access keys are needed only for larger retrieval volumes; normal use has quotas.

attribution: Attribute SEPA as specified in the selected dataset/service metadata.
limitations: Retain measurement datum, quality status, time interval and units.
Data access volume is restricted; optional keys do not remove licence obligations.
Hydrometry is distinct from modelled flood zones and warnings.

name: SEPA flood mapping and Floodline

licence.name: Product-specific; listed flood layers OGL
licence.scope: Some open flood layers have explicit OGL attribution; Floodline API requires an access request.

attribution: Use the attribution for the chosen SEPA product and its version.
limitations: No UK-wide flood layer is implied.
Flood alerts, historic extents and modelled hazard zones answer different questions.
A mapping result cannot replace site-specific flood assessment.

name: Spatial Hub Scotland

licence.name: Open datasets OGL; premium/other datasets have separate rights
licence.scope: National open datasets require a free account/authkey; premium and bespoke products require eligible entitlements.

attribution: Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2026 and Scottish local authority data from the Spatial Hub; add further product credits if required.
limitations: Never expose an authkey through a public client-facing map.
Academic access does not imply permission to redistribute premium datasets.
National standardisation does not guarantee every local authority supplied complete data.

name: data.gov.scot catalogue

licence.name: Dataset-specific licences
licence.scope: Catalogue and data resources have distinct rights; inspect dataset metadata.

attribution: Attribute the original data publisher and product.
limitations: Catalogue discovery is not proof of current endpoint availability or open reuse.
No adapter is included in this release.

name: Natural Resources Wales open APIs

licence.name: Open API product terms; inspect product licence
licence.scope: Free signup/API key required; terms and attribution are attached to each API product.

attribution: Contains Natural Resources Wales information © Natural Resources Wales and Database Right. All rights Reserved.
limitations: No safety-critical availability guarantee is provided.
Current alerts, five-day risk forecasts and measured water levels are distinct products.
Credentials and applicable quotas must be configured.

name: DataMapWales
coverage: Wales; some layers have wider extents

licence.name: Dataset-specific; OGL where stated
licence.scope: Public catalogue/layers are available, while restricted licensed data require sign-in. Read each layer metadata.

attribution: Use the selected layer publisher, version and attribution statement.
limitations: Not all catalogue content is public or openly reusable.
Map services and downloadable feature datasets are different interfaces.
Coverage and precision must be checked per layer.

name: GSNI / OpenDataNI / Spatial NI
provider: Geological Survey of Northern Ireland and NI publishers

licence.name: Product-specific; some OpenDataNI distributions OGL
licence.scope: Do not assume a blanket licence across geology, chemistry, boreholes and site reports; retain individual distribution rights.

attribution: Attribute GSNI/BGS and any data owner as specified in product metadata.
limitations: Regional 1:250,000 mapping is not a site investigation.
BGS GB borehole and landslide tools must not be described as complete NI coverage.
No adapter is implemented in the current release.

name: NESO Data Portal

licence.name: NESO Open Licence where explicitly assigned
licence.scope: The NESO Open Licence applies only to datasets explicitly associated with it; inspect each dataset licence.

attribution: Supported by National Energy SO Open Data (for datasets under that licence).
limitations: Recommended maximum CKAN rate is one request/second; datastore two requests/minute.
Open system datasets do not reveal all local distribution or buried cable assets.
Avoid arbitrary SQL and unbounded queries.

name: Environment Agency LiDAR DTM/DSM and survey metadata

licence.name: Open Government Licence
licence.scope: Applies to the documented EA LiDAR product; retain survey/product attribution and licence metadata.

attribution: Use the Environment Agency copyright/database-right statement for the selected survey/product version.
limitations: DTM and DSM represent different surfaces.
Pixel spacing is not positional or vertical accuracy.
Composite tiles can combine surveys of different ages; verify height datum and CRS.
Not UK-wide and not a current site survey.

name: OS Premium data packages and APIs
coverage: Product-specific; many datasets cover Great Britain

licence.name: OS product/account licence
licence.scope: Requires entitlement and valid key/OAuth credentials; redistribution/derived-use terms vary by product.

attribution: Use the precise OS licence and product attribution statement.
limitations: OpenData API access does not confer Premium rights.
Academic or PSGA access cannot be assumed for every user.
No Premium adapter is included in the current release.

name: UK public-sector API catalogue

licence.name: API-specific licences and access restrictions
licence.scope: The catalogue explicitly says inclusion does not mean an API is publicly accessible.

attribution: Credit the API/data publisher and follow its terms.
limitations: A directory entry is not an implemented MCP tool.
Access and licence must be verified at the publisher.

name: Local-authority open data and asset records
coverage: Authority-specific; all UK nations require separate discovery

licence.name: Dataset-specific; no blanket local-authority licence
licence.scope: Council public catalogues include open products, but highways inspection, drainage, ownership and private records can have distinct terms/access.

attribution: Attribute the publishing authority and any third-party rights holder.
limitations: No central service contains every council asset record.
Missing published data does not establish absence of an asset or hazard.
No unrestricted arbitrary portal scraping is provided.
